hero.subtitle: Rugged edge hardware and a cloud intelligence platform, designed, installed, integrated and operated by ADP with our AIoT partner. We lead with water and extend the same platform to energy and other infrastructure.

challenge.title: Mapped to Saudi regulators
challenge.body: We lead with water, where national targets are clearest. Each of our six water solutions is mapped to a Saudi mandate.

opportunity.title: Start with monitoring, grow to autonomous operations
opportunity.body: A structured pathway: every stage builds on the last, on the same architecture, with no rebuild. Clients start with monitoring and grow, stage by stage, to prediction, optimization, autonomous action and national-level governance. The Saudi Internet of Things market is forecast to grow from USD 10.7B in 2025 to USD 30.3B in 2034.

capabilities.title: Field Assets
capabilities.body: Layer 1, physical infrastructure: sensors and smart meters, PLCs and SCADA, pumps, wells and reservoirs, substations and plants.

capabilities.title: Edge Intelligence
capabilities.body: Layer 2, gateways and connectivity: rugged IP65/IP67 gateways; 4G, LoRa, Wi-Fi and LAN; MQTT, Modbus and OPC-UA; local processing and buffering.

capabilities.title: Central Intelligence
capabilities.body: Layer 3, AI and analytics platform: time-series data platform, anomaly and failure prediction, demand forecasting and automated compliance reports.

capabilities.title: Command Centre
capabilities.body: Layer 4, executive and government: GIS asset map, KPIs vs 2030 targets, board and ministerial reporting, and a sovereign audit trail.

capabilities.title: Security at every layer
capabilities.body: The customer owns the data. AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, role-based access and masking, blockchain-anchored audit logs and a zero-trust network policy.

capabilities.title: ADP's role
capabilities.body: Site survey, solution design, installation and commissioning, integration with existing SCADA and authority portals, and 24x7 Edge Ops through ADP Managed Services.

applications.title: Groundwater Monitoring
applications.body: Real-time well telemetry, over-extraction alerts and automated reporting. Aligned to the MEWA electronic-metering mandate.

applications.title: Water Level & Leak Detection
applications.body: Reservoir, tank and storage levels with leak and pressure alerts. Aligned to the National Water Strategy 2030.

applications.title: Smart Pump Automation
applications.body: Demand-driven control of borewell, tank, distribution and industrial pumps. Aligned to the National Water Strategy 2030.

applications.title: Water Quality Monitoring
applications.body: Continuous BOD, COD, pH and dissolved-oxygen monitoring at treatment plants. Aligned to the Treated Wastewater Reuse Policy.

applications.title: Smart Water Metering
applications.body: Automated reading, billing integration and tamper alerts. Aligned to the NWC smart-meter program.

applications.title: Infrastructure Asset Management
applications.body: A GIS-mapped, predictive view of every reservoir, pump and meter. Aligned to SWA · WERA reporting standards.

outcomes.label: IoT devices deployed in live operation by our partner
Layers, from field assets to the command centre

vision2030.body: Six smart-water solutions mapped to MEWA, NWC and SWA, with KPIs tracked against 2030 targets in the command centre.

deployment.note: Deployment options: shared or dedicated cloud, Saudi sovereign / government cloud, private data center or air-gapped network.

extras.title: Maturity pathway
items: Stage 1 · Monitor: real-time data, alerts, compliance dashboards
Stage 2 · Understand: AI assistant, historical analysis, document Q&A
Stage 3 · Predict: failure prediction, anomaly detection, demand forecasting
Stage 4 · Optimize: energy efficiency, resource allocation
Stage 5 · Act: autonomous controls, closed-loop operations
Stage 6 · Govern: national oversight, audit, sovereign data control

extras.title: Commercial model
items: Entry offer: pilot zone POC on a defined set of wells, reservoirs or meters
Project: hardware supply, installation, integration and commissioning
Recurring: platform subscription per device or site, plus managed Edge Ops

extras.title: Beyond water
items: Feeds Predictive Operations and Sovereign AI with live field data
